intro: Juice Delivery is an errand running between Darkshire and the western edge of Duskwood. Tavernkeep Smitts entrusts you with a potent concoction known as Zombie Juice to deliver to the reclusive hermit, Abercrombie. While ostensibly meant to keep the shivering old man warm, the brew's uncanny potency raises eyebrows.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: ...and be careful with this stuff. It's strong enough to raise the dead!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights. Did you get it for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A thousand thanks, friend. You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!
Here you are, friend. Take this as a token of my gratitude.
